title: Golf reinforced platoon participates in TIMBERTORCH

paragraphs.text: PARTICIPATED IN OPERATION TIMBERTORCH The 1st Platoon (Rein), "G" Co, under the command of 2ndLt W. W. JAFFKE participated as aggressors in the U.S. Army Operation Timbertorch which was conducted by the 3rd Brigade, 5th Infantry Divi- sion (Mechanized), Fort Carson, Colorado, at Marine Corps Base, Camp Pendleton, California.
